notes.title: Progress Report & Thanks
notes.notes:
[h3]Thank you for playing Electrogical![/h3]

We’ve received a lot of feedback—especially messages saying “I want to play more!”—and we truly appreciate it.  
As the game is currently in Early Access, we're actively working on adding new content.

[h3]Around 30 types of pieces are now ready![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517504/8b8c67b6e933c4fd17294d9a0599aa42f481a62b.png[/img]

We’re now creating new stages that make full use of these pieces. Next, we’ll begin testing and fine-tuning their balance and behavior.

[h3]The story continues![/h3]

The main story also has more to come. We're working on adding the next chapter along with new stages.

We take your feedback on game length seriously, and we’re committed to [b]delivering meaningful updates[/b] moving forward.

During Early Access, we plan to continue growing the game based on your feedback.  
We hope you’ll keep supporting Electrogical—thank you!

notes.title: Electrogical Early Access has begun! Join us on our game-making journey!
notes.notes:
[h1]The Journey Begins[/h1]

Electrogical Early Access was released on Nov.22, 2024(JST).

I'm happy to share this news with you all.

And it means that the journey to make the game is about to begin.

We want to refine Electrogical's [b]jigsaw puzzle x arithmetic operations[/b] system.

This can't be completed in the developer's head alone. We need players to play the game and think about what is fun and what is not. I think this is the beginning of a journey to gain deeper insight into the game Electrogical.

We consider all players who have purchased and played the game to be an important part of the journey to make the game.

And we sincerely hope to receive feedback from you all. We believe that Electrogical can be further polished by receiving feedback.

Please join us on this journey to make the game. Let's enjoy the game, give feedback, and enjoy the updates together as we walk towards completion.

We look forward to your feedback on the Steam community.

[h1]Sole developer kinjo[/h1]

Electrogical is developed almost entirely by kinjo alone. This has its pros and cons.

[h2]Advantages[/h2]

The advantage is that it allows for very flexible development. Decisions can be made as quickly as possible, such as changing specifications and reflecting feedback. We can be close to all players, listen to their voices, and update the game quickly. We look forward to updating the game while discussing together.

[h2]Disadvantages[/h2]

The disadvantage is that there are limitations to the speed and scale of development because it is a single developer. In that respect, kinjo will solve this problem by prioritizing the parts that have the greatest impact on the fun of the game to the extent that he can.

[h1]Enjoy[/h1]

There are still many ideas that we want to add. Please look forward to the elements that will be added as we determine the direction of the game based on feedback.

We hope that Electronical will make your daily life a little more enjoyable.


[i]*Please note that this text has been machine translated from Japanese.[/i]

notes.title: Electrogical Feedback Report - July 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank You for Your Feedback[/h1]

It’s been almost a year since we released the Steam demo of Electrogical. During this time, we have received a lot of feedback and made several changes based on it. Here, we would like to share some of the important feedback and how we have addressed it.

[h1]Careful Handling of Score Attack[/h1]

The demo was designed to offer a complete game experience. As such, towards the end of the demo, we included a Score Attack stage, which is originally intended to be end-game content. We have received feedback from players who appreciate the depth of this stage, as well as from those who feel overwhelmed by its complexity. From this feedback, we understand that the Score Attack stages in the full game need to be handled with care.

[h1]More Detailed Explanation of Score Chips[/h1]

Currently, the explanations for the effects of score chips are minimal. We are considering adding more comprehensible images, videos, and explanations to make them easier to understand. We are also challenging ourselves to design an optimal learning curve through stage composition.

[h1]Continuous Updates[/h1]

We believe it will be difficult to address all the feedback we have received before the Early Access release. However, even during Early Access, we plan to continue prioritizing feedback and making updates as much as possible.

[h1]Feel Free to Provide Feedback[/h1]

Thank you very much for all the feedback so far. We hope to continue improving the Electrogical playing experience together with all of you. Please feel free to leave a review on the store or submit your feedback through the feedback form.

notes.title: Here's a game that combines jigsaw puzzles with arithmetic problems to great success
notes.notes: n upcoming indie puzzler takes on the complexity of circuits by reducing them to familiar puzzle pieces and simple math. In Electrogical, set to release this year and with a demo out now, you'll place pieces on the board to form a chain that adds, subtracts, divides, and multiplies to reach a set output—but the pieces you have are fixed in shape and rotation, the boards are weird sizes, and you might not need every part you have to succeed... Read more.
